hints.title: Connected Component Grouping
hints.text: Any pair of indices connected directly or indirectly via swap pairs can exchange values freely.

hints.title: Alternating Sign Contributions
hints.text: Even indices carry positive weights while odd indices carry negative weights in the alternating sum.

hints.title: Component Greedy Assignment
hints.text: Within each component, assign the largest numbers to positive even indices and smallest numbers to odd indices.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Union-find connectivity clustering followed by component sorting.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating individual swap sequences leads to factorial permutations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Maintains parent and component arrays of size N.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use disjoint set union to identify swap equivalence classes and sort greedily.
